quarterly_data.signal: First half to September 30, 2025 (semi-annual report): on strong sales of CMP products for advanced semiconductors and polishing materials for silicon wafers, net sales were JPY 33,496 million (+8.9% YoY), operating profit JPY 6,469 million (+13.4%), ordinary profit JPY 6,257 million (+11.3%) and profit attributable to owners of parent JPY 4,671 million (+6.9%). Segments: Japan sales JPY 19,425 million (+11.5%), segment profit JPY 5,552 million (+21.2%); North America sales JPY 3,845 million (-6.4%, mainly lower lapping materials for small-diameter silicon wafers), segment profit JPY 178 million (-8.3%); Asia sales JPY 8,975 million (+9.1%; CMP products for advanced logic rose while hard-disk substrate products fell), segment profit flat at JPY 2,297 million (+0.0%) on forward-looking expense increases including headcount; Europe sales JPY 1,251 million (+26.0%), segment profit JPY 100 million (+42.9%). Management states the semiconductor market is led by demand for advanced devices for AI, and PC, smartphone and automotive demand is beginning to show signs of bottoming, though a full recovery appears likely to take a while longer.
quarterly_data.figure: H1 net sales JPY 33,496 million (+8.9%); operating profit JPY 6,469 million (+13.4%)

quarterly_data.signal: First-half sales by main application (semi-annual report): CMP products JPY 16,732 million (+11.3%), on higher sales for advanced logic and advanced memory; silicon-wafer lapping materials JPY 3,711 million (-2.1%) and polishing materials JPY 6,928 million (+13.1%); hard-disk substrate products JPY 1,000 million (-22.5%) because of customers' production-process improvements, although customer utilisation stayed strong; general industrial abrasives JPY 3,511 million (+33.1%), helped by Nanko Ceramics, made a subsidiary in the prior year. Construction in progress rose by JPY 8,416 million in the half (to JPY 17,175 million at September 30, 2025); first-half R&D expenses were JPY 2,834 million.
